sections.heading: 🌍 Macro tone
sections.content: The macro environment is firmly risk-off, driven by escalating Iran threats in the Middle East following a tanker strike in Hormuz and regulatory scrutiny surrounding Nvidia. Asian equities retreat broadly, led by the ASX 200 down 1.79% and the Nikkei 225 down 1.34%.

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content:
Crude benchmarks drift lower with WTI at 85.44 down 0.33% and Brent at 92.19 down 0.27% despite rising Middle East supply anxieties. Traders continue to monitor the Hormuz situation alongside the Brent-WTI spread sitting at $6.75.
Cross-asset read
US 10-year yields decline 3.3bp to 5.121% while the US dollar index holds steady at 103.53 amid broad equity weakness. Precious metals find safe-haven bids with Gold up 0.60% to 3,876.20 and Silver up 1.35% to 47.41.
